Package aor.proj3t.util.validatorutils.fordto

Class EvaluationValidator

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.validatorutils.fordto.EvaluationValidator
@ApplicationScoped public class EvaluationValidator extends Object
Validator class for evaluation-related DTOs and domain constraints.

Provides centralized validation logic for evaluation entities, such as ID checks, feedback length enforcement, scale and status validation, and constraints for evaluation cycle ranges. Ensures correctness before data proceeds to service and persistence layers.
